abstract: Let $(X,\mathcal E)$ and $(Y,\mathcal F)$ be uniformly locally finite coarse spaces. We prove that every $C^*$-algebra isomorphism $C_u^*(X,\mathcal E)\cong C_u^*(Y,\mathcal F)$ forces $(X,\mathcal E)$ and $(Y,\mathcal F)$ to be bijectively coarsely equivalent. This completely resolves the isomorphism rigidity problem for uniform Roe algebras over arbitrary uniformly locally finite coarse spaces.
title: Isomorphism rigidity of uniform Roe algebras over arbitrary uniformly locally finite coarse spaces
